title: The Feather's Memory
summary: The stasis pod glass shatters; Ha-Jun catches Tae-Jun in his arms. Kuro's Fallen Feather hovers above Tae-Jun's chest, awakening ancient memories of the 5,000-year-old covenant.

panels.shot: stasis pod glass exploding in slow motion shower of cyan sparks
panels.action: The twenty-foot pressurized glass cylinder detonates into a dazzling cascade of cyan crystal shards and vapor.
panels.prose_en: The twenty-foot pressurized glass cylinder detonates into a dazzling cascade of cyan crystal shards and vapor.
panels.prose_hi: Bees foot ka dabaavyukt kaanch ka cylinder siyan crystal tukdon aur vashp ke chamakdar jharne mein visphotit hota hai.

panels.shot: cyan coolant liquid rushing across the frosted floor
panels.action: Thousands of liters of fluorescent cyan coolant wash across the freezing floor, steaming in the zero-degree air.
panels.prose_en: Thousands of liters of fluorescent cyan coolant wash across the freezing floor, steaming in the zero-degree air.
panels.prose_hi: Hajaron litre fluorescent siyan shitalak shunya degree hawa mein bhaap bankar, barfeeli farsh par bah jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun catching tae-jun body in his arms before he touches floor
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides across the wet stone on his knees, catching Tae-Jun's limp, soaking wet body safely against his chest.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hyung! I've got you! Main aa gaya!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides across the wet stone on his knees, catching Tae-Jun's limp, soaking wet body safely against his chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne ghutnon ke bal gile patthar par fisalta hai, taaye-jun ki langadahat ko pakadta hai, gile shareer ko apni chhati par surakshit roop se bhigota hai.

panels.shot: close-up on tae-jun pale, chilled face with small demonic horns
panels.action: Tae-Jun's skin is deathly pale, covered in frost; two small obsidian horns protrude gracefully from his temples.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's skin is deathly pale, covered in frost; two small obsidian horns protrude gracefully from his temples.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki tvacha ghatak roop se pili, paale se dhaki hui hai; uske mandiron se do chhote obsidian seeng khubsurti se ubhre hue han.

panels.shot: tae-jun breathing shallowly but eyes rolling back weakly
panels.action: Tae-Jun's chest rises weakly; black necrotic veins pulse under the skin of his neck: 'Ha... Jun...'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's chest rises weakly; black necrotic veins pulse under the skin of his neck: 'Ha... Jun...'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki chhati kamjor roop se upar uthti hai; uski gardan ki tvacha ke neeche kali necrotic nasen fadkati han: 'ha...jun...'.

panels.shot: kuro flapping down landing on tae-jun sternum
panels.action: Kuro lands gently on Tae-Jun's chest, his talons radiating warm violet magic into the young man's sternum.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Void corruption uske soul-core tak pahunch chuki hai. Ordinary medicine can't save him.

panels.prose_en: Kuro lands gently on Tae-Jun's chest, his talons radiating warm violet magic into the young man's sternum.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro dheere se taaye-jun ki chhati par utarta hai, uske panje yuvak ke urosthi mein garm baingani jadu bikherte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun desperately channeling healing mana from his hands
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses both palms to Tae-Jun's chest, flooding him with crimson-violet sovereign mana, but the black veins reject it.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera healing mana kaam kyun nahi kar raha?! It's bouncing right off!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses both palms to Tae-Jun's chest, flooding him with crimson-violet sovereign mana, but the black veins reject it.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun donon hatheliyon ko taaye-jun ki chhati par dabata hai, jisse wah lal-bangni samprabhu man se bhar jata hai, lekin kali nasen ise aswikar kar deti han.

panels.shot: kuro fallen feather detaching from ha-jun collarbone
panels.action: The original Fallen Feather from Episode 2 begins to glow with blinding, hypnotic neon-magenta celestial fire.
panels.prose_en: The original Fallen Feather from Episode 2 begins to glow with blinding, hypnotic neon-magenta celestial fire.
panels.prose_hi: Episod 2 ka mool fallen feather chkachaundh, sammohak nion-magenta akashiya aag se chamakne lagta hai.

panels.shot: feather hovering weightlessly between the two brothers
panels.action: The feather rotates in mid-air, casting sacred runic circles of light that illuminate both brothers' faces.
panels.prose_en: The feather rotates in mid-air, casting sacred runic circles of light that illuminate both brothers' faces.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh madhya hawa mein ghumta hai, jisse prakash ke pavitra runic vritt nikalte hain jo donon bhaiyon ke chehre ko roshan karte han.

panels.shot: kuro voice echoing with deep divine resonance
panels.action: Kuro's voice drops into an ancient, reverberating tone: 'The First Memory of the Covenant is ready to speak.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Five thousand years ago... An oath was written in the stars.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's voice drops into an ancient, reverberating tone: 'The First Memory of the Covenant is ready to speak.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki awaaz ek prachin, gunjate hue swar mein badal jaati hai: 'vacha ki pehli smriti bolne ke liye taiyar hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun foreheads touching as the vision begins
panels.action: A bridge of golden starlight connects the brothers' brows; reality dissolves into a blinding cosmic flashback.
panels.prose_en: A bridge of golden starlight connects the brothers' brows; reality dissolves into a blinding cosmic flashback.
panels.prose_hi: Sunhari taron ki roshni ka ek pul bhaiyon ki bhaunhon ko jodta hai; vastavikta ek andhere brahmandiya flashback mein vilin ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: cosmic flashback: primordial cosmos before earth existed
panels.action: An ocean of violet nebulas, spinning galaxies, and burning comets in the dawn of creation.
panels.prose_en: An ocean of violet nebulas, spinning galaxies, and burning comets in the dawn of creation.
panels.prose_hi: Srishti ke aarambh mein baingani neeharikaon, ghumti akashgangaon aur jalte dhumketuon ka ek mahasagar.

panels.shot: first sovereign asmodaius standing on a dying star
panels.action: First Sovereign Asmodaius in his living prime—an immortal titan in obsidian dragon plate armor, majestic and noble.
panels.prose_en: First Sovereign Asmodaius in his living prime—an immortal titan in obsidian dragon plate armor, majestic and noble.
panels.prose_hi: Apne jeevit kaal mein pratham samprabhu esmodius - obsidian dragon plate kavach mein ek amar titan, rajsi aur mahan.

panels.shot: beside him: the colossal primordial nether crow monarch
panels.action: Beside Asmodaius perches a thousand-foot celestial crow made of pure purple solar flares and cosmic fire: Kuro's true progenitor.
panels.prose_en: Beside Asmodaius perches a thousand-foot celestial crow made of pure purple solar flares and cosmic fire: Kuro's true progenitor.
panels.prose_hi: Esmodius ke bagal mein shuddh baingani saur jwalaon aur brahmandiya aag se bana ek hajar foot ka divya kauwa baitha hai: kuro ka sachcha purvaj.

panels.shot: the void primordial entity tearing through the fabric of reality
panels.action: Opposite them, a shapeless horror of black tentacles and dying stars—The Void Primordial—attacks the universe.
panels.prose_en: Opposite them, a shapeless horror of black tentacles and dying stars—The Void Primordial—attacks the universe.
panels.prose_hi: Unke viparit, kale jaalon aur marte sitaron ka ek aakarhin aatank - the void primordial - brahmand par hamla karta hai.

panels.shot: asmodaius and kuro fighting side by side against the void
panels.action: Asmodaius wields a blade of pure starlight while Kuro's wings deflect planets, fighting to protect mortal life.
panels.prose_en: Asmodaius wields a blade of pure starlight while Kuro's wings deflect planets, fighting to protect mortal life.
panels.prose_hi: Esmodius shuddh taron ki roshni ka ek blade chalata hai jabki kuro ke pankh grahon ko vikshepit karte han, nashwar jeevan ki raksha ke liye ladte han.

panels.shot: the covenant forged: asmodaius sealing his soul into ten relics
panels.action: Knowing his mortal vessel will fall, Asmodaius forges his power into nine relics, and Kuro sheds his single primary feather as the tenth.

dialogue.text: Nine relics of power... And one feather of living soul.

panels.prose_en: Knowing his mortal vessel will fall, Asmodaius forges his power into nine relics, and Kuro sheds his single primary feather as the tenth.
panels.prose_hi: Yah jaante hue ki uska nashwar jahaj gir jaega, esmodius ne apni shakti ko nau avsheshon mein badal diya, aur kuro ne dasven ke roop mein apna ekal prathmik pankh gira diya.

panels.shot: asmodaius whispering his final prophecy to kuro
panels.action: Asmodaius smiles gently: 'When my bloodline awakens in the distant future... Guide them, my old friend.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Meri legacy ek mortal child mein jaagegi. Guard him until he can surpass me.

panels.prose_en: Asmodaius smiles gently: 'When my bloodline awakens in the distant future... Guide them, my old friend.'.
panels.prose_hi: Esmodius dheere se muskurata hai: 'jab door ke bhavishya mein meri vanshavali jagti hai... to unka margdarshan karo, mere purane dost.'

panels.shot: kuro compressing his 1,000-foot body into a small black raven
panels.action: Kuro willingly surrenders his godhood, folding his cosmic wings until he fits in the palm of a mortal hand.

dialogue.text: Ek devta ne apni immortality chhod di... Sirf ek vaade ke liye.

panels.prose_en: Kuro willingly surrenders his godhood, folding his cosmic wings until he fits in the palm of a mortal hand.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro swechha se apne ishwartv ko tyaag deta hai, apne laukik pankhon ko tab tak modata hai jab tak wah ek nashwar haath ki hatheli mein fit nahin ho jata.

panels.shot: flashback ending: vision returning to the freezing chamber
panels.action: The cosmic vision recedes; Ha-Jun opens his eyes, staring at little Kuro perched on Tae-Jun's chest with new awe.
panels.prose_en: The cosmic vision recedes; Ha-Jun opens his eyes, staring at little Kuro perched on Tae-Jun's chest with new awe.
panels.prose_hi: Laukik drishti peeche hat jaati hai; ha-jun ne apni aankhen kholin aur naye vismay ke saath taaye-jun ki chhati par baithe chhote kuro ko dekha.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes brimming with tears of profound reverence for kuro
panels.action: Ha-Jun whispers: 'Kuro... You gave up your godhood... for us?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro... Tum ek Primordial God the... And you stayed by my side in the rain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whispers: 'Kuro... You gave up your godhood... for us?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun fusfusata hai: 'kuro... tumne apna ishwartv tyaag diya... hamare liye?'.

panels.shot: kuro tilting his head giving a faint, grumpy bird chuckle
panels.action: Kuro ruffles his black feathers: 'Hmph. You were a pathetic, crying brat. Someone had to make sure you didn't die.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Main apna vaada nahi todta, Ha-Jun. Never.

panels.prose_en: Kuro ruffles his black feathers: 'Hmph. You were a pathetic, crying brat. Someone had to make sure you didn't die.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne kale pankh fadfadata hai: 'hamf. tum ek dayniy, ​​rone wale ladke the. kisi ko yah sunishchit karna tha ki aap maren nahin.'

panels.shot: the feather descending gently onto tae-jun heart
panels.action: The glowing feather settles directly over Tae-Jun's sternum, sinking into his flesh like liquid purple mercury.
panels.prose_en: The glowing feather settles directly over Tae-Jun's sternum, sinking into his flesh like liquid purple mercury.
panels.prose_hi: Chamakta hua pankh sidhe taaye-jun ke urosthi par sthit hota hai, aur taral baingani pare ki tarah uske maans mein doob jata hai.

panels.shot: the black necrotic veins on tae-jun neck stopping their spread
panels.action: The black poison lines freeze in their tracks, held at bay by the Mythic Feather's divine warmth.
panels.prose_en: The black poison lines freeze in their tracks, held at bay by the Mythic Feather's divine warmth.
panels.prose_hi: Mithik feather ki divya garmahat ke karan kali jahar ki rekhaen unki patriyon par jam jaati han.

panels.shot: tae-jun face relaxing into peaceful, stable slumber
panels.action: Tae-Jun's breathing stabilizes into deep, steady rhythms; the immediate threat of death is halted.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Mera feather uski body ko 24 ghante tak freeze rakhega. But to cure him completely, we need the Hourglass.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's breathing stabilizes into deep, steady rhythms; the immediate threat of death is halted.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki shwas gahri, sthir lay mein sthir ho jaati hai; mrityu ka tatkal khatra ruk gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun carefully lifting tae-jun onto his back in piggyback carry
panels.action: Ha-Jun lifts his older brother onto his back, securing his arms over his shoulders with gentle, unbreakable strength.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne mujhe saalon tak uthaya hai, Hyung. Ab meri baari hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lifts his older brother onto his back, securing his arms over his shoulders with gentle, unbreakable strength.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne bade bhai ko apni peeth par uthata hai, uski baahon ko uske kandhon par komal, atoot takat se surakshit karta hai.

panels.shot: the chamber roof cracking violently as a deafening roar shakes the spire
panels.action: The massive stone dome above cracks open; debris showers down as an ungodly draconic roar reverberates.
panels.prose_en: The massive stone dome above cracks open; debris showers down as an ungodly draconic roar reverberates.
panels.prose_hi: Upar ka vishal patthar ka gumbad daraaron se khul jata hai; ek adharmi krur dahaad ke roop mein malba barasta hai.

panels.shot: shadow of a 100-foot void dragon casting darkness over the floor
panels.action: Through the cracked ceiling, the colossal silhouette of Sixth Void Sovereign Vaelgor blocks out the stars.
panels.prose_en: Through the cracked ceiling, the colossal silhouette of Sixth Void Sovereign Vaelgor blocks out the stars.
panels.prose_hi: Tuti hui chhat ke madhyam se, chhathe shunya samprabhu velgor ki vishal chhaya taron ko avruddh kar deti hai.

panels.shot: kuro eyes narrowing with ancient primordial wrath
panels.action: Kuro hops onto the stone railing, his eyes igniting with twin stars of violet nova fire: 'Vaelgor... You insolent lizard.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: You dare show your face before me?!

panels.prose_en: Kuro hops onto the stone railing, his eyes igniting with twin stars of violet nova fire: 'Vaelgor... You insolent lizard.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro patthar ki railing par chadh jata hai, uski aankhen baingani nova aag ke judwan sitaron se prajvalit ho rahi han: 'velgor... tum dheeth chhipkali.'

panels.shot: kuro body bursting into a blinding pillar of sovereign fire cliffhanger
panels.action: Kuro's body erupts into a 100-foot column of sacred purple and crimson flame, about to reveal his true form!
panels.prose_en: Kuro's body erupts into a 100-foot column of sacred purple and crimson flame, about to reveal his true form!.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ka shareer pavitra baingani aur lal rang ki lau ke 100 foot ke stambh mein badal gaya, jo uske asli roop ko prakat karne wala tha!
